data.name: Edward
data.gender_notes: Edward is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English ead, 'wealth', + weard, 'guardian'. Its root is Old English ead + weard. Saint Edward the Confessor, king of England. Edward is a English name meaning “Wealthy guardian; rich guard”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Edward expresses “Wealthy guardian; rich guard”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Old English ead, 'wealth', + weard, 'guardian'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Edward total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
